title: Fix TypeScript composite project errors in plugin packages
body:
TypeScript compilation was failing in CI with TS6059/TS6307 errors when plugin packages imported from `@object-ui/types` workspace dependency. The `rootDir` constraint in composite projects was rejecting transitive source files from external packages.

## Changes

Standardized `tsconfig.json` for three plugin packages to match working configuration pattern:
- `plugin-kanban`
- `plugin-markdown` 
- `plugin-object`

**Configuration diff:**
```diff
 {
   "compilerOptions": {
-    "outDir": "./dist",
-    "rootDir": "./src",
-    "composite": true,
-    "declarationMap": true
+    "outDir": "dist",
+    "jsx": "react-jsx",
+    "baseUrl": ".",
+    "paths": { "@/*": ["src/*"] },
+    "noEmit": false,
+    "declaration": true,
+    "composite": true,
+    "declarationMap": true,
+    "skipLibCheck": true
   },
-  "include": ["src/**/*"]
+  "include": ["src"]
 }
```

The `skipLibCheck` option allows TypeScript to skip checking declaration files from dependencies while maintaining type safety through compiled `.d.ts` files. Removing `rootDir` permits source files from workspace packages to be included in compilation.

Aligns with existing configuration in `plugin-aggrid`, `plugin-charts`, and `plugin-editor`.
